decisive_spans.text: A well-demarcated, warm, erythematous plaque, 15 × 12 cm, was seen over the right side of the anterior chest wall around her operation scar. Scattered within the erythema were multiple palpable small nodules.

response.rationale: The vignette describes a presentation highly consistent with inflammatory breast carcinoma, including a warm, erythematous plaque with palpable nodules. While D5 (Inflammatory Breast Cancer) is also a strong candidate, D3's description is more precise and directly aligns with the provided clinical details.
